text:

Traditional SEO focuses on keywords and backlinks, but **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** and **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** focus on _entity authority, structured data, and third-party mentions_ so AI platforms choose to recommend your business by name. ### 1\. Dedicated & AI-Native Specialists

They focus heavily on off-page brand sentiment, forum/review site footprints, and third-party validation—the exact signals AI models use to determine which local business to trust and recommend. ### 2\. Established Arizona Digital Agencies with GEO/AEO Services

  * **DigiFlex360:** A well-known local agency operating across Phoenix and surrounding areas that offers transparently priced AEO services. They target featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, voice search, and Google AI Overviews.

[Phoenix, AZ Search Engine Optimization Agency - REV77](https://www.rev77.com/digital-marketing-services-phoenix-az/geo-aeo)

### What to Look for When Choosing an Agency

Because AEO/GEO is a newer discipline, many traditional SEO agencies simply re-label old keyword services. To ensure you get results for your local Arizona market, look for these criteria:

  1. **Off-Page Brand Mentions Focus:** AI models don't just read your website; they aggregate opinions from Reddit, review aggregators, YouTube, and local directories. A good agency actively manages your broader digital ecosystem. [Top AEO and AI SEO Agencies in Arizona for 2026](https://aeo-collective.com/blog/top-6-phoenix-arizona-marketing-agencies-for-aeo-ai-seo-geo-2026/#:~:text=Why%20its%20approach%20works%3A%20AEO%20Collective's%20strategy,alongside%20on%2Dsite%20content%20structured%20for%20AI%20extraction.)

  2. **Entity & Schema Optimization:** They must implement advanced local business schema (JSON-LD) so AI crawlers instantly understand your service areas, hours, and core offerings.

  3. **Prompt-Level Tracking:** Ensure they track whether ChatGPT or Perplexity actually recommends your business when a local customer asks high-intent questions (e.g., _"Who is the best HVAC repair company in Mesa?"_).
